reasoning: Tomato stem cut longitudinally reveals dark brown/black pith discoloration with intact green outer cortex. This presentation — diagnostic longitudinal stem cut showing internal pith discoloration — matches Southern_Bacterial_Wilt, which specifically manifests as dark or light brown discoloration in the pith area. Sclerotinia was ruled out because its outer cortex becomes bleached/white (not green), and sclerotia appear as discrete black bodies in white pith rather than continuous dark discoloration.
